items.title: Why Circle's IBM patent deal matters for crypto
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Circle Internet Group's (CRCL) acquisition of nearly 1,000 blockchain patents from IBM (IBM) and explains what the deal signals as blockchain technology continues to evolve into core financial infrastructure. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: The D-Wave Quantum Bet: How an Expanded AT&T Deal Is Boosting the Stock
items.summary: In the quantum space, commercial traction is often the strongest signal of progress.  The quantum developer unveiled an expanded partnership with  AT&T  on Monday to deploy its signature annealing systems.  AT&T isn’t a new collaborator; D-Wave first teased the relationship earlier this year, when representatives from the telecom giant appeared at D-Wave’s annual user conference.
